name: "errors_undeclared_reference"
rule:
  variables:
    - name: val
      expression: spec.labels
  match:
    - condition: "true"
      output: |
        "invalid: %s".format([variables.val])

name: "errors_undeclared_reference"
description: "Tests for undeclared references in policy compilation"
sections:
- name: "compile"
  tests:
  - name: "undeclared_reference"
    output:
      error_set:
      # Tolerate either 'spec' or 'spec.field'
      - "undeclared reference to 'spec"

value.description: Tests for undeclared references in policy compilation
value.name: errors_undeclared_reference
